svg.aria-label: Two quoted panels: second- and third-order Runge–Kutta in t or λ against DPM-Solver at 12 to 48 NFE, and DDPM, Analytic-DDPM, DDIM, Analytic-DDIM and DPM-Solver on one CIFAR-10 model from 10 to 1,000 NFE
svg.text: QUOTED FROM DPM-SOLVER (NEURIPS 2022) · FID ON CIFAR-10, LOWER IS BETTER
GREEN: SECOND ORDER · OCHRE: THIRD ORDER
Left: continuous-time VP model; RK in t on uniform t steps, the rest on uniform λ steps. Right: DDPM's discrete-time model.
DPM-Solver at end time 10⁻³ up to 15 NFE and 10⁻⁴ above, as the paper advises; 46 NFE is its adaptive run. Lu et al. 2022, Tables 1 and 4.
